name: AGERASIA
source:
You will follow Camden Connolly, born and raised in the Modern Era, they find themselves in an unfamiliar situation alongside seven other colourful characters, each from a different Era of human history - going as far back as Prehistory, all the way up to the Distant Future. Finding themselves at the whims of a curious floating blobfish known as Rantan, the eight are tasked with using time travelling lanterns to compete against each other in a bid to restore a supposed reality-bending world event. 

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/oliviawestmorland/agerasia-anthological-visual-novel-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
你将跟随在现代时代出生和长大的卡姆登·康诺利，他们发现自己与其他七个丰富多彩的角色一起处于一个陌生的境地，每个角色都来自人类历史的不同时代 - 可以追溯到史前时代，一直到遥远的未来。八人发现自己受到了一只名为兰坦（Rantan）的好奇漂浮水滴鱼的突发奇想的影响，他们的任务是使用时间旅行灯笼相互竞争，以恢复一个所谓的扭曲现实的世界事件。

[编辑自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/oliviawestmorland/agerasia-anthological-visual-novel-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
